analysis.imageCoordinates: pixel edges, x right, y down, origin top-left; bounds are [x0,y0,x1,y1) when enumerating pixels
analysis.blenderUv: u=x/width; v=1-y/height; hulls counter-clockwise in UV space
analysis.cutout: outer 12-direction supporting-plane hull, 1 pixel guard, clamped to atlas; contains exact opaque pixel hull

storage.semantics: grayscale map values; PNG alpha channel is not the opacity source

rejectedComponents.reason: Below 64 opaque pixels or below 4 pixels in either dimension; source remains untouched.
